question: What loss on ignition did the kerogen extracted from the oil shale have, and what does the national standard require?
expect: 88%; the standard requires an LOI greater than 75% (sec. 2.3.3)
rendered:
<document title="A Study on Pyrolysis Characteristics and Product Release Mechanisms of Oil Shale">

=== page 3 ===
- Upon testing, the loss on ignition (LOI) of the kerogen prepared in this experiment was 88%, satisfying the regulatory requirement of an LOI greater than 75% specified in the national standard.

</document>

The loss on ignition of the kerogen extracted from the oil shale was 88%, which satisfies the national standard's requirement of greater than 75%.
